deviations.claim_in_article: “We Thought It Was AI” and the account that the call seemed AI-driven before the voice was revealed to be a person.
deviations.issue: The article presents an actual belief and recognition during a call. The Japanese source only says users might think Muse was making the call; the Ledger confirms that humans handled some calls, but does not establish that anyone thought a particular call was AI or recognized the caller as human during it.
deviations.explanation: The hypothetical possibility in the source becomes an asserted experience in the article, adding an unverified belief/recognition. This does not contradict the verified fact that humans handled some Muse calls, but that experience is not established by the Ledger.
